At this stage, the EcuInstance is configured. The execution order is defined by scheduling tasks, and assigning Software Component Runnables to these tasks. Finally , the Basic Software Modules are configured. After the RTE is generated, the complete code is compiled and linked into an executable.⌋(RS_METH_- 00006, RS_METH_00208) 8 7See Figure 2.6 and chapter 2.6 for more details. 8See Figure 2.7.
